provenance.type: OCC positive-y fluid domain, not a clipped full mesh

contact_diagnostics.curve_endpoint_topology: Only non-TE curves are connected into components when they share an OCC endpoint point tag; TE curves are excluded before union.
contact_diagnostics.projection_method: Curve endpoint y values plus sign-changing roots of OCC dy/du found by uniform parameter scan and scipy brentq; sampled extrema and brackets are retained per curve.
contact_diagnostics.sampling_error_note: maximum_sampled_y_step and bracketing y sample range are resolution diagnostics, not certified global error bounds for arbitrary CAD curves.
contact_diagnostics.surface_curve_discovery: Union of OCC surface boundary curves and Gmsh mesh embedded curves from getEmbedded(2, surface_tag); a shared curve must occur on both a selected wall surface and a selected wake surface.
